name: gradileo
description: Gradileo — a mastery-based, AI-assisted mathematics learning platform for teachers and students.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/spa-fallback.mjs
scripts.functions:deploy: node scripts/sync-engine.mjs && supabase functions deploy grade-submission ai-agent ai-tutor create-students send-emails admin-users join-class
scripts.functions:check: node scripts/sync-engine.mjs && cd supabase/functions && npx -y deno@2.1.4 check grade-submission/index.ts ai-agent/index.ts ai-tutor/index.ts create-students/index.ts send-emails/index.ts admin-users/index.ts join-class/index.ts
